headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 18-19, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tommy Nance earning the win. Nathan Lukes led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and one RBI. The Cleveland Guardians took down the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. The Minnesota Twins dominated the Texas Rangers 9-3, with Trevor Larnach hitting 3 home runs and driving in 3 runs. The Seattle Mariners shut down the Baltimore Orioles in a 3-0 shutout victory, with Bryan Woo earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Angels center fielder Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other notable injured players include Everson Pereira of the Chicago White Sox, Cole Ragans of the Kansas City Royals, Spencer Strider of the Atlanta Braves, Chase DeLauter of the Cleveland Guardians, Max Scherzer of the Toronto Blue Jays, Gleyber Torres of the Detroit Tigers, and Will Wilson of the Seattle Mariners.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals taking place. Hunter Stratton, a right-handed pitcher, was traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded right-handed pitcher Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded catcher Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash, while the Kansas City Royals traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Denis Samudio and cash.
